test_staticmethods.title: test_staticmethods
test_staticmethods.code:
def test_staticmethods():
    assert isinstance(Color.__dict__["hex2rgb"], staticmethod)
    assert isinstance(Color.__dict__["rgb2hex"], staticmethod)
    # static methods also work through an instance
    assert Color("red").hex2rgb("#00ff00") == (0, 255, 0)

test_asymmetric_channels_and_both_instan.code:
def test_asymmetric_channels_and_both_instance_converters():
    color = Color('red')
    assert color.hex2rgb('#0102Fe') == (1, 2, 254)
    assert color.rgb2hex((1, 2, 254)) == '#0102fe'

courseHelp.title: Course help
courseHelp.body:
Write your implementation above the supplied tests. Run checks the sample tests. Submit checks all supplied tests. Keep the tests and runner unchanged.

For an older saved solution, use **+** beside the editor tabs to open the current template. Copy your implementation into the new tab. Your old tab stays in place.

The template and tests are recreations based on the public bite description. Python 3.11. Use the standard library. No network access.

[Original Pybites exercise](https://pybitesplatform.com/bites/implement-a-color-class-with-staticmethod/)
